tei:div.tei:p: 587) gnam chos thugs gter gyi cha lag bka' srung a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i mchod gsol sman btsun dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 588)

e dbyings stong chen kun bzang mo// wam̐ yig bde chen sgyu 'phrul gar/ zung ngag sman btsun tshul bzung ba// d+dharma tā res dge legs stsol// de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gsar rnying bka' gter du mar byon pa rnams kyi ya gyal rnam snang lo tsā ba shud bu dpal seng zung gi sgyu 'phrul rig 'dzin chen po tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyi zab gter las byung ba 'don bder khrigs su bsdebs pa la/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ sku rten spyan gzigs sogs kyis mdzes par spras pa'i gong du rtsa gsum spyi yi gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba rgyan spros dang*/ g.yas su srung ma gtso bsdus kyi gtor ma/ g.yon du 'di nyid kyi gtor ma rnams gzab rgyan/ mdog mtshungs kyi dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi g.yas su sman phud dang*/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du zhi drag mdzugs sprod kyi nyer spyod rnams bkod legs su bshams/ de dag gi mdun ngos nas/ ja chang 'o phud/ zas sna 'byor tshad kyis brgyan pa'i mchod gtor sogs kyang 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma 589) dang zla ba'i gdan la bdag nyid rtsa gsum kun 'dus snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags shing*/ khro 'dzu+um sgeg pa'i lang tsho can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas bhan+dha ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba'i nang du 'chi med kyi tshe bum 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wām̐ ga/ sku la gsang gos dkar po 'du ma dmar po/ phod kha sngon po/ chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris can/ za 'og gi ber smug rnams brtsegs mar gsol ba/ dbu la 'dab ldan pad+ma'i gnyen zhu dang*/ zhabs la sag lham gsol zhing g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa'i rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su 'ja' zer thig le mer mer shig shig tu 'phro ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o//

gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag dbang rtags su 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par bsam la/ thugs kar 590) nyi zla la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis lhun gyi grub par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis 'od gsal bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa gyis sgyu ma lta bu'i lhar ldang ngo*// mchod rdzas rlob pa ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal med khang chen por rin po che'i snod rnams su mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ khyad par gyi mchod rdzas rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung mi thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ye shes ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa rnams kyi nang du gtor ma dang bdud rtsi oṃ bh+rum̐ swa āṃ hā muṃ lāṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ las lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ steng gi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs la bstims pas sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*/ gtor ma bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon gyi 591) sprin 'phro ba/ rak+ta ra yig las ru dhe ra'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs las 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'das gtor ni/ snying ga'i 'od kyis rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ni nam mkha' gang bar sad par mos la/ hūm̐/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni// zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*// thugs rje'i nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/

'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa spyan drangs zhing bstim/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar mos la/ oṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍal de bag ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod (592)rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa yi// zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang sogs kyi phrin las bcol/ chos skyong spyi bsdus kyi gtor bsngo dang*/ mgon chen sogs kyi phrin las kyang skabs 'di nyid du sbyar ro/ lha mo'i phrin las dngos ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta= stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du 'od snang las grub pa'i skyed mos tshal/ chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa lta bur yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug pa ne'u sing sman ljongs me tog du mas bkra ba'i gnas ri dwags sna tshogs bag pheb par rgyu zhing 'bab chu lhung lhung dang bya skad snyan par sgrog pa/ mtha' skor gangs ri'i rwa ba dang ljon shing du mas bkra ba'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa'i khang bzang them skas rim pa gnyis pa kha bad can gyi nang du/ rin po che'i khri dang dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi steng du aṃ las dpal ldan dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro a phyi chos kyi sgron ma chu shel gyi phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ dar zab dkar po'i ber chen (593)gser gyi pad+ma ris dmar po'i mtshon cha bkram pa lta bu'i g.yang lug rma bya'i mdongs kyi cha ga can/

phyag g.yas mda' dar sna lnga dang*/ g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi me long 'dzin pa/ shin tu mdzes pa'i 'jo sgeg 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu la rin po che gser g.yu me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ gangs ri ltar dkar ba'i rta mchog rlung gi gshog pa sga srab sogs rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa can la bcebs pa/ mdun du lha mo sngon mo/ g.yas su ser mo/ rgyab du dmar mo/ g.yon du ljang mo/ bzhi ka'ang rgyan dang phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mtshungs pa rkang thang gi tshul du gnas pa/ mtha' bskor du gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa'i gzugs dang cha lugs can phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bas 'dod pa'i dngos grub char bzhin du 'bebs pa nam mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin du 'khor par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ (594)thugs srog sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phraus pas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul/ brag dkar ti sgro/ 'dan gyi brag rtsa/ 'bri gung gi mthil sogs/ rang rang gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas dpal ldan dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gi// bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa'i// dpal ldan a phyi chos sgron ma// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir spyon// hūm̐/ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// ma mo gsang ba'i sku gcig byung ba ni// las bzhi'i gzugs 'chang sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul ston// glog ltar 'khyug cing gang la'ang thogs pa med// dus bzhin nyul cing bstan pa'i dam rdzas srung*// dpal gyi bka' nyan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ma// chos kyi sgron ma mchod 'khor bcas pa rnams// nub phyogs o rgyan yul dang ti sgro'i brag/ 'dan gyi brag rtsa 'bri gung mthil la sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas ma thogs rings par spyon// oṃ ya ma rā tsa/

ma ma 'dus/ sarba (595)'dus/ ra tsa 'dus/ ma ma 'dus/ e h+ya hi/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ pho brang rab mdzes gzhal yas 'dir// dar zab 'bol brtsegs gdan gyi steng*// ma gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dpal ldan dbyings kyi mamakha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gter ston gnam lcags me 'bar/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje la sogs te rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar gsang chen bla na med pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad phrin 'phel ba dang*/ bstan pa la phan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi chos srid dbang thang dar ba dang*/ bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig 596) mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i// mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun// g.yag lug bya ra ri dwags chu nas gzugs// mda' dar me long sba gling zas sna'i phud// phye mar spos dkar bsang shing dud pa'i sprin// 'phyar dar g.yab dar mchod sgrub skong ba'i rdzas// 'bru sna sman sna go khrab spyan gzigs tshogs// gser skyems 'o zho ja chang phud rgod dang*// shing thog dar zab bal tshon shug tel sogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mthun rdzas dpag med kyis// sman btsun mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ pañca ḍāki ni sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ= ru pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi/

bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ gtsang dang dme ba'i rtog pa rab grol zhing*// ra sa ya na 'chi med sman chen po// nyon mongs rnam rtog 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi che// sman btsun ḍāki'i tshogs rnams dgyes par rol// sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ 597) gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang maṃ sa dang*// zhu zhing khol ba zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod// 'dod lnga'i rang bzhin ma hā bā ling ta// sngags kyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// ma hā ba ling ta khā hi/ rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ nyams pa bsgral ba'i zhing chen lhu dum 'khrigs// rak+ta'i lbu phreng rus pa'i ri rab brtsegs// ghir ta'i lha mo rdul snyed kun tu 'phro/ chags rtog bde chen dag phyir bzhes su gsol// ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ bstod pas mnga' gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzhi dbyings gdod nas rnam grol kun bzang mo// gzhi snang rig pa'i ye shes rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug dbyings rig dbyer med a phyi mchod// sku gsum gdod ma'i yum mchog ma la bstod// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid chos kyi dbyings// lhan skyes mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gdong*// thugs rje'i rtsal snang thogs med rol pa'i gar// chos kyi sgron ma mched 'khor bcas la bstod// ras dkar kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la// zla 'od 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i lang tsho can/ 598) /mdzes 'dzum bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur cir yang ngom// bcu drug dga' ba'i mchog sbyin khyod la bstod// reg 'jam dbang po'i gzhu yis 'khri shing can// zla zhun 'thags su btags pa'i lha rdzas dang*// srid pa'i 'byor pa spungs pa'i yon gyis kyang*// mi khug dbyig gi nor bus mdzes la bstod// myur gyogs glog gi zhags pas mtshon min pa'i// mgyogs 'gro ngang dkar rlung gi gshog can bc-ibs// zhi mdzad sngo sangs rgyas mdzad gser gyi mdog /dbang mdzad rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin rnams la bstod// drag mdzad ljang mo kun kyang rang mdog gis// lha rdzas ber chen lhab lhub g.yang lugs gsol// sna lnga'i mda' dar dngul dkar me long 'dzin// gar stabs tshul du 'gying zhing brjid la bstod// gzhan yang bka' nyan las byed bstan pa srung*// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs// grangs med yid bzhin 'khor lor 'char la bstod/

/de nas dregs pa spyi dang bye brag pa rnams skabs 'dir gtang*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar zla ba la 599) gnas pa'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas mngon par 'dod pa'i las rab 'byams thogs med du sgrub par mos la/ gong non gyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa dang*/ oṃ ya ma ra tsa swa hāḥ ma ya 'dusaḥ rā tsa 'dusaḥ ma ma 'dus swa hāḥ zhes bzla/ las dmigs la sgrub par 'dod na zur du shes/ thun mtshams su gsol skong sogs ci rigs par 'bad/ grangs gsog pa'i tshe/ hrī: yum gcig a phyi chos sgron ma// sku mdog dkar mo mdzes pa'i gzugs// g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon me long*// sku la dar sngon ber chen gsol// rta dkar phur shes chibs su bcibs// 'khor du lha mo bzhi yis bskor// sku mdog sngo ser dmar ljang bzhi// rkang thang phyag mtshan gtso dang mtshungs// ma gcig a phyi mched lnga po// o rgyan yul dang ti sgro brag /'dan gyi brag rtsa 'bri gung mthil// bzhugs gnas rnams nas 'dir spyon la// dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma dang*// yid sprul mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa (600)la// rims nad yams nad med pa dang*/ rigs brgyud chos brgyud dar zhing rgyas// longs spyod mnga' thang 'phel ba dang*// snang srid dbang du 'du bar mdzod// mched lnga ma g.yel las mdzod cig /oṃ ya ma rā tsa swa hā/ ya ma 'dusaḥ sarba 'dusaḥ rā tsa 'dusaḥ ma ma 'dusaḥ i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hiḥ pañca a mṛ ta kha hiḥ sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes snying rje'i dbang phyug chags med zhabs kyi rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs che ba nyid ji ltar 'os pa bsag phrin las gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe kun bzang pad+ma thod phreng gis// sku gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mo yis// tha tshig rdo rje yal gam gnyer du gtad// rgyal bstan srung ma chen por dbang yang bskur// bar du khrag 'thung he ru ka dpal che// gnam lcags me 'bar brgyud par bcas pa yi// bka' nyan dam gnas sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// bstan pa sder bcas srung ma'i gtso bo mchog

/tha ma rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje yis/ srung mar gnyer blangs zhal bstan srog snying phul// 'da' dka' rdo rje'i dam tshig deng dgongs la// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa 601) mchog /'jig rten khams su yun du bzhugs nas kyang*// phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun tu khyab pa dang*/ thos bsam sgom pas yun du 'dzin gyur cig /de tshul bshad dang sgrub pa'i mtsho chen la// rtag dang gus pas rol pa'i zla dbang che// ris med rgyal bstan gsar pa'i rten mchog rnams/ sku tshe mdzad phrin yar ngo'i zla ltar mdzod/ 'dzin ma'i khyon kun nad mtshon mu ge sogs// nyer 'tshe'i rgud pa ming yang mi grag cing*// bde skyid dbyar gyi mtsho mo rdol ba dang*// mngon mtho'i yon tan rgya mtsho 'byor bar mdzod/ khyad par dam tshig gnad nas skul ba ni// 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyis// nyams chag nyes ltung 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i bgegs// dag tshangs chen po'i dngos grub bdag la stsol// byang chub sgrub la phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs// bdud kyi bslu brid rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi dang*// chos brgyad chos ltar bcos pa'i bar chad rigs// ming tsam med par myur du brlag par mdzod// mi med lung stong dben (602)pa'i ri sul du// sring ba gnyis ldan sbyangs pa'i yon gyis phyug /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i 'byor pas brgyan pa dang*// nad med tshe dbang sgrub par mdzad du gsol// rtog pa'i rgyun thag ka dag klong du chad// 'khrul pa'i rdzun ris chos kyi dbyings su rdib// zang thal rig pa gcer bu ling nge ba// bar med chos sku'i ngang du mnal bar mdzod// yong yul gang yang chos sku'i rol par shar// ye grol lhun 'byams chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong*// byar med ye srung rgyal po'i dam la gnas// spang blang las 'das gzhon du bum sku'i dbyings// khams gsum 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod/

/de nas rjes chog sogs spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa don kun grub pa'i gsung bskul bzhin rgyal bstan ris med la nagus pa 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros pas bris pa kun tu dge bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o//
